changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS leave_mgmt;

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE leave_mgmt.leave_types ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, is_paid BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, default_days_per_year NUMERIC(5,2), carry_over_max_days NUMERIC(5,2), carry_over_expire_months INT, require_attachment BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, min_notice_days INT DEFAULT 0, max_consecutive_days INT, is_system BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, UNIQUE (tenant_id, code) );
CREATE TABLE leave_mgmt.leave_balances ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, leave_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES leave_mgmt.leave_types(id), year INT NOT NULL, initial_balance NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL, carry_over NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, used NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pending NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, remaining NUMERIC(5,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (initial_balance + carry_over - used - pending) STORED, UNIQUE (employee_id, leave_type_id, year) ); CREATE INDEX idx_bal_emp_year ON leave_mgmt.leave_balances(employee_id, year);

changeSet.author: hirevo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE leave_mgmt.leave_requests ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, leave_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES leave_mgmt.leave_types(id), start_date DATE NOT NULL, end_date DATE NOT NULL, total_days NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL, reason TEXT, attachment_url TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled')), approval_instance_id UUID, approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ, cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE INDEX idx_leave_emp_date ON leave_mgmt.leave_requests(tenant_id, employee_id, start_date); CREATE INDEX idx_leave_status ON leave_mgmt.leave_requests(tenant_id, status);

changeSet.author: hirevo
hirevo
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO leave_mgmt.leave_types (tenant_id, code, name, is_paid, default_days_per_year, carry_over_max_days, carry_over_expire_months, require_attachment, is_system) SELECT NULL, code, name, is_paid, days, carry_max, expire, req_attach, TRUE FROM (VALUES ('annual', 'Cuti Tahunan', TRUE, 12, 6, 3, FALSE), ('sick', 'Cuti Sakit', TRUE, 365, 0, 0, TRUE), ('maternity', 'Cuti Melahirkan', TRUE, 90, 0, 0, TRUE), ('paternity', 'Cuti Suami Menemani Istri', TRUE, 2, 0, 0, FALSE), ('marriage', 'Cuti Menikah', TRUE, 3, 0, 0, FALSE), ('bereavement', 'Cuti Duka (Keluarga Inti)', TRUE, 2, 0, 0, FALSE), ('religious', 'Cuti Ibadah (Haji/Umrah)', TRUE, 40, 0, 0, TRUE), ('menstruation','Cuti Haid (Opsional)', TRUE, 2, 0, 0, FALSE), ('unpaid', 'Cuti Tanpa Bayaran', FALSE, 0, 0, 0, FALSE), ('permit', 'Izin', TRUE, 0, 0, 0, FALSE), ('wfh', 'Work From Home', TRUE, 0, 0, 0, FALSE) ) AS x(code, name, is_paid, days, carry_max, expire, req_attach);
